==Russian==

===Alternative forms===
* {{alter|ru|мѣша́ть||ru-PRO}}

===Etymology===
{{inh+|ru|orv|мѣшати}}, from {{inh|ru|sla-pro|*měšati}}. Akin to {{m|ru|меси́ть}}.

===Pronunciation===
* {{ru-IPA|меша́ть}}
* {{audio|ru|Ru-мешать.ogg}}

===Verb===
{{ru-verb|меша́ть|impf|pf=размеша́ть,смеша́ть,перемеша́ть,помеша́ть}}

# to [[stir]]
# to [[mix]], to [[mingle]], to [[blend]]
# to [[mix up]], to [[confuse]]
# to [[hinder]], to [[impede]], to [[prevent]], to [[interfere]] with {{+obj|ru|dat<someone/something>}}
#: {{pf|ru|помеша́ть|q1=only}}
# to [[bother]], to make [[difficulty|difficulties]], to [[hurt]] a little
